HHS.createStarDevice.description: Creates an HHS (Hamilton Heater Shaker) device instance attached to a STAR node.

HHS.createUsbDevice.description: Creates an HHS (Hamilton Heater Shaker) device instance attached via USB.

HHS.getDeviceIds.description: Returns the list of registered HHS device IDs and their connection info.

HHS.getStatus.description: Returns the current shaking speed, temperature, and temperature control status for HHS devices.

HHS.setPlateLock.description: Locks or unlocks the plate lock on an HHS device.

HHS.startShaker.description: Starts shaking on an HHS device at a specified speed and duration.

HHS.startTempControl.description: Starts temperature control on an HHS device at a target temperature.

HHS.stopShaker.description: Stops shaking on an HHS device.

HHS.stopTempControl.description: Stops temperature control on an HHS device.

HHS.terminate.description: Disconnects and releases an HHS device.

HHS.waitForShaker.description: Waits until shaking has completed on an HHS device.

HHS.waitForTempControl.description: Waits until temperature control has stabilized on an HHS device.

WXS.getWeight.description: Returns a stable or dynamic weight value from the balance scale.

WXS.initializeBalance.description: Establishes a connection to the balance scale.

WXS.internalCalibration.description: Starts an internal adjustment (calibration) procedure on the balance scale.

WXS.setScaleParameters.description: Sets general balance scale parameters (weighing mode, vibration, stability, weight unit, auto zero).

WXS.setZero.description: Sets a new zero point on the balance scale, clearing the tare memory.

WXS.tare.description: Tares the balance scale and returns the tare weight change.

WXS.terminateBalance.description: Terminates the connection to the balance scale.
